meta.name: Windows apps (Wine + VM tier) demo
meta.author: you
meta.description: Run Windows applications on the desktop. TWO TIERS (docs/strata-design.md §14): the `wine` tier installs small apps directly (each in its own prefix) — that's the `apps` list below, and it happens at install time. The `vm` tier is for what Wine can't run (CAD, kernel anti-cheat, Store apps): a real Windows in a container, with individual apps shown as normal windows via WinApps + FreeRDP. The VM tier is NEVER set up automatically — it installs a whole Windows — so run `manifest windows-vm --file <this>` when you want it, then `manifest windows-vm --link` once Windows finishes installing. Leave `password` out and one is generated.
